headline: Bitcoin heads into tonight's weekly close on track for a fifth straight losing week, Binance warns some USDT deposits may be frozen as hack withdrawals reopen, and OKX's CEO warns users against sending funds straight from MEXC after a US Treasury cut-off order.

market.asOf: Read about 19:56 UTC Sun 8 Nov (02:56 Mon Bangkok) from CoinGecko coin pages. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 28 (Fear), up from 25 (Extreme Fear) the day before. CoinMarketCap's own index shows 32.

stories.title: Bitcoin is on track for a fifth losing week as tonight's weekly close nears
stories.summary: Bitcoin's weekly candle closes at 00:00 UTC Monday (07:00 Bangkok). To end the losing streak it must close above the week's opening price, which CryptoTicker puts at $78,232 and crypto.news at $78,354. It spent Sunday just under $76,000. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.28 billion over 2-6 November.
points: Bitcoin traded between $75,540 and $76,106 over the 24 hours to 12:20 UTC Sunday, and 24-hour trading volume fell 58%, per IBTimes.
Weekly closes have fallen about 12.4% since the 4 Oct close of $86,507, per CryptoTicker. The week's high was $81,131 on Wednesday and the low $74,722 on Friday.
Daily ETF flows for 2-6 Nov: -$398.6M, -$115.6M, +$74.6M, -$430.2M and -$411.9M, per CryptoTicker. BlackRock's IBIT alone lost about $1.21B over the week, per Analytics Insight.
Altcoins fell harder over the week: ENA -18.6%, NEAR -15.2%, HYPE -12.0%, per crypto.news.

stories.title: Binance warns some USDT deposits could be frozen as hack withdrawals reopen
stories.summary: Binance co-CEO Yi He warned users that USDT linked to Myanmar or Cambodia deals, or to informal off-exchange trades, could trigger source-of-funds checks or freezes. HYPE and APT withdrawals reopened on 8 November; INJ, Plasma, NEAR and LTC are targeted to reopen by the end of the week starting 9 November. CFO Kaiser Ng has also left, in a change Yi He says was planned six months ago.
points: Sources differ on the 29 Oct hack: about $6.3B per Nairametrics, about $6.34B per crypto.news.
They also differ on how much Binance has covered: about 90% per Nairametrics, about 95% per one crypto.news report and 98% of token assets per another.
About $2.85B has been frozen or intercepted, per crypto.news.
Justin Yek, formerly VP of finance at Airwallex, replaces Ng, per Nairametrics citing Bloomberg.
Separately, Binance will close accounts in France, Spain, Italy and Poland on 31 Dec and charge 0.025% of the balance a month (minimum 10 USDC) from 29 Nov, per crypto.news.

stories.title: OKX warns users about MEXC transfers after the US Treasury moves to cut MEXC off
stories.summary: The US Treasury's FinCEN ordered US financial institutions to stop moving money to or from MEXC Global, starting 30 days after the order is published in the Federal Register. Treasury paired it with sanctions on eight Canadian money businesses accused of moving Iranian funds. OKX's CEO warned users not to send funds straight from MEXC to OKX. MEXC says it is operating normally.
points: Sources differ on the total: at least $16B over May 2021-May 2026 per crypto.news, about $16.7B per Cryptopolitan.
About $1B went directly to or from more than 40 Iranian exchanges, per crypto.news; about $1.5B is tied to Russian sanctions evasion, per Cryptopolitan.
MEXC says it has started an independent review of its anti-money-laundering and sanctions controls, per Cryptopolitan.

briefs.title: What Democrats winning Congress means for crypto
briefs.summary: Democrats are projected to hold at least 54 Senate and over 253 House seats. A crypto market-structure bill now faces slim odds, with Sen. Elizabeth Warren set to chair Senate Banking, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply has its steepest weekly drop of 2026
briefs.summary: Total supply fell $6.66B in the week to 7 Nov to $292.31B, per DefiLlama data, with USDT down $3.10B and USDC down $1.31B.

briefs.title: Web3Auth says it moved $5.6M out of exposed Keplr wallets
briefs.summary: After the social-login wallet drain, Web3Auth says it moved about $5.6M into 12 recovery addresses ahead of the hackers, per The Block. Seed-phrase and hardware wallets were not affected.

briefs.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy buy
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor posted his Sunday bitcoin tracker chart, which usually comes before a Monday purchase notice. Strategy held 849,327 BTC at an average cost of $75,451, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Vitalik: value ETH as a store of value, not a fee-burner
briefs.summary: Buterin says the case for ETH's fee burn was weaker than it appeared; only about 19,200 ETH has been burned in 2026, per The Block.

briefs.title: Trump Media moves 4,259 BTC to Crypto.com
briefs.summary: The coins, worth about $343.7M, back convertible notes whose holders can demand up to about $1B on 30 Nov; no sale is confirmed, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Travel-rule rollback published 9 Nov
briefs.summary: A Federal Register notice formally withdraws the 2020 plan to cut the crypto record-keeping threshold from $3,000 to $250.
